summary: Fix review passed: prior 500-on-invalid-month failure is resolved with consistent 400 handling for invalid year/month inputs across budget/dashboard flows, overflow risk from unchecked year-to-short conversion is mitigated, and added controller/service tests cover the targeted edge cases (including invalid months 0 and 13).
